reference.title: Review, Compare, Stage, and Commit Actions

dlentry.dd: Contextual menus in the Unstaged files area, the Staged files area, and affected-resource lists.
The selected file, folder, or submodule.
The selected resource opens in the main editing area or in the relevant system tool.

section.title: Open in Compare Editor
section.p: Opens a comparison for the selected changed resource.

dlentry.dd: Contextual menu of a resource in the Unstaged files area. You can also double-click a changed resource.
The selected changed file.
Use this action before staging changes so you can confirm that the file belongs in the next commit.

section.title: Git Diff
section.p: Compares the selected resource with its repository version.

dlentry.dd: Git submenu in the Project view contextual menu.
The selected resource.

section.title: Stage
section.p: Moves the selected unstaged resources to the Staged files area.

dlentry.dd: Contextual menu of the Unstaged files area.
Selected unstaged resources.
Stage only the files that belong in the next commit.

section.title: Stage Selected
section.p: Moves the selected unstaged files to the Staged files area.

dlentry.dd: Stage controls between the Unstaged files and Staged files areas in the Git Staging view.
Selected unstaged files.

section.title: Stage All
section.p: Moves all unstaged files to the Staged files area.

dlentry.dd: Stage controls between the Unstaged files and Staged files areas in the Git Staging view.
All unstaged files in the current working copy.
Use this action only when all current changes belong in the same commit.

section.title: Unstage Selected
section.p: Moves the selected staged files back to the Unstaged files area.

dlentry.dd: Stage controls between the Unstaged files and Staged files areas in the Git Staging view.
Selected staged files.

section.title: Unstage All
section.p: Moves all staged files back to the Unstaged files area.

dlentry.dd: Stage controls between the Unstaged files and Staged files areas in the Git Staging view.
All staged files in the current working copy.
Contextual menu of the Unstaged files area.
Selected unstaged resources.
Use this action only when you are sure that you no longer need the local changes.

section.title: Commit
section.p: Saves the staged changes to the local repository with the message entered in the Commit message area.

dlentry.dd: Commit button in the Git Staging view. A resource-specific Commit action is also available in the Project view contextual menu.
Staged files, or the selected resource when the contextual action starts the commit workflow.
Write a clear message and include only related changes in one commit.

section.title: Generate Commit Message Using AI
section.p: Uses AI Positron to generate a commit message for the staged changes.

dlentry.dd: Toolbar above the Commit message area in the Git Staging view.
Staged changes.
Review the generated message before committing.

section.title: Choose a Previously Used Comment
section.p: Lets you reuse a previous commit message.

dlentry.dd: Toolbar above the Commit message area in the Git Staging view.
The commit message field.

section.title: Automatically Push Changes to Remote Branch
section.p: Pushes the committed changes to the remote repository after the commit is performed.

dlentry.dd: Toolbar above the Commit message area in the Git Staging view.
The next commit operation.
Use this option only when you are ready to publish the commit immediately.

section.title: Amend Last Commit
section.p: Combines staged changes with the most recent commit or edits the last commit message.

dlentry.dd: Toolbar above the Commit message area in the Git Staging view.
The latest local commit and the current staged changes.
Do not amend public commits, which are commits that were already pushed to the remote repository.
